training_weights: N_train/(S_train*n_rows_in_training_study); mean row weight1; each study equal total weight
preprocessing: training-only numeric median; six fixed numeric missing indicators; Ridge-only training sample-weighted numeric StandardScaler; train-only categorical vocabulary with fixed MISSING token; OHE handle_unknown=ignore plus six fixed unknown indicators; all derive only from12 source predictors

decision_rule.primary_loss: study_equal RMSE; negative model-minus-baseline delta means improvement
decision_rule.multiplicity: one-sided upper percentile bound at 1-0.05/12 for3models*2primarydesigns*2mean_baselines; secondary function not in conclusion gate
decision_rule.model_design_supported: upper adjusted paired deltaRMSE<0 vs both training mean baselines; point study_equal R2>0; point study_equal MAE and observation MAE/RMSE no worse than both mean baselines; point RMSE under both weights no worse than zero-response baseline
decision_rule.GENERALIZABLE_SIGNAL: A and B each have at least one supported prespecified model; can be different models, no deployable winner selected
decision_rule.STUDY_GENERALIZES_CROP_TRANSFER_WEAK: A has a supported model, B does not
decision_rule.LIMITED_GENERALIZABLE_SIGNAL: A does not have a supported model; any B-only support reported descriptively
decision_rule.interpretation: conservative prespecified conditional uncertainty classification, not formal causal inference or proof that any possible algorithm cannot generalize

bootstrap.CI: 95% percentile; no refitting; conditional on fixed out-of-fold predictions

_scope: Method-only extraction from the archived Phase1 protocol; not the byte-identical frozen protocol and not sufficient to start analyses. Cohort counts, data fingerprints, frozen memberships and results withheld.
